description: Investigate .kqspreset import only after lawful format validation, sample-file analysis, dependency mapping, and documented limits; make no compatibility promise.

title: AUv3 instrument extension
description: Evaluate an AUv3 instrument extension architecture, host lifecycle requirements, resource limits, and parameter exposure before committing to support.

title: Inter-app audio routing
description: Assess supported modern iOS audio routing integrations and licensing requirements, with explicit validation of latency and application lifecycle behavior.

title: Native SpessaSynth audio backend
description: Benchmark supported SpessaSynth integration approaches for iOS, including threading, audio scheduling, packaging, memory use, and applicable license obligations.

title: Reference synthesis comparison player
description: Compare representative GM, GS, and XG passages against documented expectations and licensed references, reporting differences without claiming hardware equivalence.

title: Soundfont modulator compatibility inspector
description: Catalog supported SoundFont modulators and generator behavior with reproducible cases before offering advanced modulation editing or compatibility claims.

title: Custom sample instrument authoring
description: Investigate importing user-owned samples into editable instruments with validated loop, mapping, envelope, and export behavior across supported formats.

title: Playback during screen lock
description: Validate background playback, interruptions, route changes, and restoration behavior across target iOS versions before defining supported operating modes.

title: Spatial audio listening modes
description: Explore optional spatial positioning for parts with measured headphone behavior, fold-down quality, resource cost, and clear user control.

title: Network ensemble synchronization
description: Investigate clock exchange, latency measurement, drift correction, and consent-based session discovery before proposing networked collaborative performance support.
